description: Use this when the user wants printable graph paper or grid paper as a PDF: square grid (1/4 inch, 5 mm, 1 mm, 4x4 or 5x5 per inch), dot grid, isometric or isometric dot, hexagon, polar, semi-log or log-log with chosen cycles, engineering paper, or a coordinate plane with numbered x and y axes. Lines are placed at true physical spacing and the grid is centred, with a calibration ruler. Up to 100 pages, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A5, A4 or A3. Does not plot data, draw graphs of functions, or make tracing worksheets.

angle_step.description: Polar only: degrees between spokes, e.g. 15 (default), 10, 5 or 30.

axes.description: Square or dot grid only: draw numbered x and y axes through the centre (a coordinate plane), e.g. true. Default false.

calibration_ruler.description: Print the 5 cm or 2 in check ruler in the bottom margin, e.g. true. Default true.

cycles.description: Semi-log and log-log: number of log cycles (decades) on the vertical axis, 1 to 6, e.g. 3. Default 3.

line_color.description: Line colour as a name or hex, e.g. "light blue", "gray", "green", "black" or "#4A7FC1". Default depends on the type.

line_weight.description: Line thickness in points or a word, e.g. 0.4, "0.25 pt", "thin" or "bold". Default 0.4 pt (dots 1.4 pt).

major_every.description: Draw a heavier line every N squares, e.g. 5 or 10. Default none (engineering: 5 per inch; 1 mm paper: 10).

margin.description: Page margin, e.g. "10 mm" or "0.5 in". Default 1/2 in on US pages, 10 mm on A pages; at least 0.2 in.

name_date.description: Print Name and Date lines at the top, e.g. true. Default false (Cornell notes: true).

orientation.description: portrait or landscape, e.g. "landscape". Default portrait.

page_size.description: Paper size: Letter, Half Letter (5.5x8.5), Legal, Tabloid (11x17), A5, A4, A3 or B5, e.g. "A4". Default Letter (A4 for millimetre paper). "8.5x11", "US letter" and "A4 landscape" also work.

pages.description: Number of identical pages in the PDF, 1 to 100, e.g. 5 or "ten". Default 1.

paper_type.description: Paper type, e.g. "square" (graph paper), "dot", "isometric", "isometric dot", "hex", "polar", "semi-log", "log-log", "engineering", "quad ruled" (4 squares per inch), "millimetre paper" (1 mm grid), or "coordinate plane" for a grid with x and y axes. Lined, Cornell, music staff, guitar tab and calligraphy also work here.

spacing.description: Grid or line spacing with a unit, e.g. "5 mm", "1/4 inch", "0.5 cm", "5 squares per inch" or "4x4". For hex: across the flats; isometric: triangle side; polar: ring spacing; music: gap between staff lines; lined/cornell: line spacing; calligraphy: x-height. Default depends on the type (1/4 in on US pages, 5 mm on A pages).

title.description: Optional heading printed at the top, e.g. "Physics lab 3". Longer titles are shortened to 80 characters. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters print.

x_cycles.description: Log-log only: log cycles on the horizontal axis, 1 to 6, e.g. 2. Default 2.

name: generate_graph_paper
title: Generate graph paper
